concept.zh: 带权单向路 · 一次免耗 · 最低总耗电
concept.en: Weighted one-way roads · One free edge · Minimum charge spent

brief.zh: size 个路口由 corridors 相连，每条为 [起点, 终点, 耗电量]，只可沿该方向走，耗电大于 0。你有一次性通行证，可以把走过的任意一条通道耗电变为 0，也可以不使用。从 start 到 exit_node 所需的最小总耗电是多少？不能到达时返回 -1。路口从 0 编号，可能有多条通道通向同一处。
brief.en: There are size junctions. Each corridor is [from, to, charge cost], travels one way, and costs a positive amount. Your single-use pass can make any one traversed corridor free, or you can leave it unused. Return the minimum total charge from start to exit_node, or -1 if no route exists. Junction indices start at zero and parallel corridors are allowed.
